_comment: unity-dev — SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for path -> codemap shard. SKILL.md, build_codemap.py and build_index.py all read this file; none of them carries its own copy of the mapping. First matching pattern wins, so order matters: Editor before UI/Gameplay, catch-all last. Patterns are gitignore-style globs relative to the project root: ** crosses directories, * stays inside one segment.

shards.name: editor
shards.note: editor-only tools; never in a build

shards.name: content
shards.note: content-driving code; the DATA assets themselves live in assetmap.md

shards.name: core
shards.note: catch-all: game flow, save, shared services
